# Bero

> Official website of Roberto Junior, known online as Bero: software engineer, creator, illustrator and founder of BeroLab.

Bero is the primary site name. Bero Land and bero.land are alternate names for the same official website.

- Canonical website: https://bero.land/
- Languages: Portuguese (primary) and English
- Contact: mail@bero.land
- Company registration (Brazil): CNPJ 61.026.871/0001-79
- Last updated: 2026-08-28

## Portugues

- [Inicio](https://bero.land/index.md): identidade, principais destinos e contato
- [Sobre o Bero](https://bero.land/about.md): biografia, carreira e trabalho criativo
- [Links do Bero](https://bero.land/links.md): perfis e canais oficiais
- [Setup do Bero](https://bero.land/setup.md): equipamentos e ferramentas atuais
- [Projetos do Bero](https://bero.land/projects.md): apps, open source e comunidade
- [Media Kit do Bero](https://bero.land/media-kit.md): audiencia, formatos e parcerias

## English

- [Home](https://bero.land/en/index.md): identity, key destinations and contact
- [About Bero](https://bero.land/en/about.md): biography, career and creative work
- [Bero's Links](https://bero.land/en/links.md): official profiles and channels
- [Bero's Setup](https://bero.land/en/setup.md): current equipment and tools
- [Bero's Projects](https://bero.land/en/projects.md): apps, open source and community
- [Bero Media Kit](https://bero.land/en/media-kit.md): audience, formats and partnerships
